item.title: Major Crisis Looms Over Odisha: Low-pressure in Bay of Bengal intensifies; Severe cyclone likely | Dynamite News
item.description: A low-pressure area has also formed in the South Andaman Sea, which will continue to move west-northwestward, strengthening further on November 24th, and becoming a depression in the southeastern Bay of Bengal. item.title: Delhi-NCR air pollution crisis deepens, AQI again above 400 | Dynamite News
item.description: Delhi-NCR continues to choke under severe air pollution, with AQI levels crossing 400 in several regions, indicating hazardous air quality. Major hotspots like Anand Vihar, Wazirpur, Rohini, and Jahangirpuri recorded “severe” pollution, posing serious health risks. Noida, Ghaziabad, and parts of Gurugram also reported alarming pollution levels.

item.title: NIA Probe: Dr Shaheen trained to brainwash UP doctors for terror mission | Dynamite News
item.description: After the Delhi blast, investigative agencies intensified operations across the country, leading to several shocking revelations. In NIA interrogation, Dr. Shaheen, arrested along with Muzammil and Dr. Adil, was reportedly trained to brainwash doctors in Uttar Pradesh and recruit them into an anti-India network.

item.title: Weather: IMD warns of temperature drop as Uttar Pradesh braces for harsh winter | Dynamite News
item.description: Cold conditions are set to intensify in Uttar Pradesh, with the India Meteorological Department warning of a sharp drop in both maximum and minimum temperatures. Dense to moderate fog is expected in several districts during early mornings, while parts of the state may face light cold-wave conditions.

item.title: Gold prices fall slightly across India amid weak global cues; Check price here | Dynamite News
item.description: Gold prices in India witnessed a slight decline today as global economic cues remained weak and domestic demand stayed moderate. The stronger dollar and fluctuating international market trends impacted local rates. While 24-carat gold traded at ₹12,584 per gram, silver remained steady at ₹164 per gram. Major cities recorded minor variations, with southern states showing comparatively higher prices.

item.title: Tejas Crash: Martyred IAF Pilot Naman Syal mortal remains reaches Coimbatore | Dynamite News
item.description: Wing Commander Naman Syal of the Indian Air Force, who was martyred in the Tejas fighter jet crash during the Dubai Air Show, arrived today at Sulur Air Force Base in Coimbatore. The Indian Air Force personnel paid a heartfelt tribute, while Coimbatore District Collector Pawan Kumar, IAS, also honored the fallen officer. The nation mourns the loss of a brave pilot whose sacrifice will always be remembered.
